insert into STD_CCD_DIAGNOSIS (DIAGNOSIS_ID, ENCOUNTER_DOC_ID, DIAGNOSIS_TEXT, DIAGNOSIS_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_CODE_SYSTEM_CODE, DIAGNOSIS_CODE_SYSTEM_OID, UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, ENCOUNTER_SEQ_NO, DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NO, ENCOUNTER_DATE) values ( #{DIAGNOSIS_ID,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{ENCOUNTER_DOC_ID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{DIAGNOSIS_TEXT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DIAGNOSIS_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DIAGNOSIS_CODE_SYSTEM_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{DIAGNOSIS_CODE_SYSTEM_OID,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{CCD_DOC_ID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{ENCOUNTER_SEQ_NO,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{DIAGNOSIS_SEQ_NO,jdbcType=INTEGER}, FN_TO_DATE(substr(#{START_DATE_TEXT,jdbcType=DATE},0,8),'MM/DD/YYYY') )
mapper.select: SELECT std.DOCUMENT_ID, std.FNAME, std.MNAME, std.LNAME, std.DOB_TEXT, std.GENDER, std.ETHNICITY, std.RACE_WHITE, std.RACE_BLACK, std.RACE_ASIAN, std.RACE_INDIAN, std.RACE_PACIFIC, std.RACE_UNKNOWN, std.RACE_OTHER, std.RACE_OTHER_TEXT, std.LANGUAGE, std.PERSON_ADDRESS, std.PERSON_CITY, std.PERSON_STATE, std.PERSON_ZIP, std.PERSON_PLUS4, std.PERSON_COUNTY, std.PERSON_PHONE, std.PERSON_ADDRESS_ID, std.PERSON_COUNTRY, std.PERSON_PHONE_HOME, std.PERSON_PHONE_CELL, std.PERSON_PHONE_WORK, std.ADDRESS_USE, std.USEABLE_PERIOD_LOW, std.USEABLE_PERIOD_HIGH, std.CREATE_DATE, std.MPI, raw1.UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID FROM STD_CCD_DOC std LEFT OUTER JOIN RAW_CCD_DOC raw1 ON std.DOCUMENT_ID = raw1.DOCUMENT_ID WHERE std.DOCUMENT_ID = #{docId}

SELECT ENCOUNTER_DOC_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, START_DATE_TEXT, END_DATE_TEXT, ENCOUNTER_TYPE, PROVIDER_FNAME, PROVIDER_MNAME, PROVIDER_LNAME, FACILITY_NAME, FACILITY_DEPT, ENCOUNTER_ID, ADMISSION_TYPE FROM RAW_CCD_ENCOUNTER WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}

SELECT MED_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, ORDERED_MEDICATION_NAME, START_DATE_TEXT, STOP_DATE_TEXT, DOSAGE_VALUE, DOSAGE_UNIT, FILLED_MEDICATION_NAME, CURRENT_MEDICATION, ORDERING_PROV_FNAME, ORDERING_PROV_MNAME, ORDERING_PROV_LNAME, FREQUENCY FROM RAW_CCD_MED WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}

SELECT PROVIDER_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, PROVIDER_TYPE_CODE, PROVIDER_TYPE_DESCRIPTION, PROVIDER_LNAME, PROVIDER_FNAME, PROVIDER_MNAME, PROVIDER_ADDRESS_1, PROVIDER_ADDRESS_2, PROVIDER_CITY, PROVIDER_STATE, PROVIDER_ZIP, PROVIDER_PHONE, START_DATE_TEXT, END_DATE_TEXT FROM RAW_CCD_PROVIDER WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}

SELECT PAYER_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, POLICY_ID, POLICY_NAME, POLICY_ADDRESS1, POLICY_ADDRESS2, POLICY_CITY, POLICY_STATE, POLICY_ZIPCODE, POLICY_COUNTRY, POLICY_COUNTY, POLICY_PHONE, MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_FNAME, MEMBER_MNAME, MEMBER_LNAME, MEMBER_ADDRESS1, MEMBER_ADDRESS2, MEMBER_CITY, MEMBER_STATE, MEMBER_ZIPCODE, MEMBER_COUNTRY, MEMBER_COUNTY, MEMBER_PHONE, MEMBER_DOB_TEXT, HOLDER_ID, HOLDER_ADDRES1, HOLDER_ADDRESS2, HOLDER_CITY, HOLDER_STATE, HOLDER_ZIPCODE, HOLDER_COUNTRY, HOLDER_COUNTY, HOLDER_PHONE, HOLDER_DOB_TEXT, START_DATE_TEXT, END_DATE_TEXT, HOLDER_FNAME, HOLDER_MNAME, HOLDER_LNAME FROM RAW_CCD_PAYER WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}

SELECT std.DOCUMENT_ID AS documentId, std.FNAME AS fName, std.MNAME AS mName, std.LNAME AS lName, std.DOB_TEXT AS dobText, std.GENDER AS gender, std.ETHNICITY AS ethinicity, std.RACE_WHITE AS raceWhite, std.RACE_BLACK AS raceBlack, std.RACE_ASIAN AS raceAsian, std.RACE_INDIAN AS raceIndian, std.RACE_PACIFIC AS racePacific, std.RACE_UNKNOWN AS raceUnknown, std.RACE_OTHER AS raceOther, std.RACE_OTHER_TEXT AS raceOtherText, std.LANGUAGE AS language, std.PERSON_ADDRESS AS personAddress, std.PERSON_CITY AS personCity, std.PERSON_STATE AS personState, std.PERSON_ZIP AS personZip, std.PERSON_PLUS4 AS personPlus4, std.PERSON_COUNTY AS personCounty, std.PERSON_ADDRESS_ID AS personAddressId, std.PERSON_COUNTRY AS personCountry, std.PERSON_PHONE_HOME AS personPhoneHome, std.PERSON_PHONE_CELL AS personPhoneCell, std.PERSON_PHONE_WORK AS personPhoneWork, std.ADDRESS_USE AS addressUse, std.USEABLE_PERIOD_LOW AS useablePeriodLow, std.USEABLE_PERIOD_HIGH AS useablePeriodHigh, std.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, std.EHARS_IMPORT_DATE as eharsImportDate, std.EHARS_STATUS_CD as eharsStatusCd, PDA.STATENO as stateno, PDA.DISCARD_STATUS, std.MPI AS mpi, std.UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID FROM STD_CCD_DOC std LEFT OUTER JOIN person_doc_association PDA ON (std.document_id = PDA.document_id AND PDA.dissassociation_date IS NULL) WHERE STD.DOCUMENT_ID = #{docId}

SELECT * from ( SELECT DOC.DOCUMENT_ID , DOC.UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID, COALESCE( ADDRESS.DOC_ID, 0 ) AS ADDR, COALESCE( PROVIDER.DOC_ID, 0 ) AS PROV, COALESCE( PAYERS.DOC_ID, 0) AS PAYER, COALESCE( LAB.DOC_ID, 0) AS LABS, COALESCE( ENC.DOC_ID, 0) AS ENCOUNTER, COALESCE( MEDS.DOC_ID, 0) AS MED, COALESCE( DIAGS.DOC_ID, 0) AS DIAG, COALESCE( LAB_RESULT.DOC_ID, 0) AS LAB_RES, COALESCE( PROBLEM.DOC_ID, 0) AS PROB FROM RAW_CCD_DOC DOC LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_PERSON_ADDRESS GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) ADDRESS ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = ADDRESS.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_PROVIDER GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) PROVIDER ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = PROVIDER.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_PAYER GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) PAYERS ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = PAYERS.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_LAB_TEST GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) LAB ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = LAB.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_ENCOUNTER GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) ENC ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = ENC.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_MED GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) MEDS ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = MEDS.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_DIAGNOSIS GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID) DIAGS ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = DIAGS.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_LAB_RESULT GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) LAB_RESULT ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = LAB_RESULT.CCD_DOC_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CCD_DOC_ID, COUNT(*) AS DOC_ID FROM RAW_CCD_PROBLEM GROUP BY CCD_DOC_ID ) PROBLEM ON DOC.DOCUMENT_ID = PROBLEM.CCD_DOC_ID ORDER BY DOC.DOCUMENT_ID ASC ) where rownum <= 1000
select * from ${table} where ${parameter} = #{docId}
SELECT RAW_CCD_ENCOUNTER_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{encounterLength}
SELECT RAW_CCD_LAB_TEST_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{labTestlength}

SELECT FNAME, LNAME, MNAME, GENDER_DESCRIPTION GENDER, DOB_TEXT DOB, PERSON_COUNTRY country, PERSON_ADDRESS, PERSON_STATE, PERSON_CITY, COUNTY_NAME PERSON_COUNTY, PERSON_ZIP, PERSON_PLUS4, ETHNICITY_DESCRIPTION ETHNICITY, PERSON_PHONE_CELL cellPhone, PERSON_PHONE_HOME homePhone, PERSON_PHONE_WORK workPhone, RACE_WHITE, RACE_BLACK, RACE_ASIAN, RACE_INDIAN, RACE_PACIFIC, RACE_UNKNOWN, RACE_OTHER, RACE_OTHER_TEXT from STD_CCD_DOC s , CODED_GENDER g , CODED_COUNTY c ,CODED_ETHNICITY e where s.gender=g.GENDER_CODE (+) AND s.PERSON_COUNTY = c.COUNTY_FIPS_CODE(+) AND s.ETHNICITY = e.ETHNICITY_CODE (+) and s.DOCUMENT_ID = #{docId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DOCUMENT_ID, FNAME, MNAME, LNAME, DOB_TEXT, GENDER, PERSON_PHONE_HOME, LANGUAGE, ETHNICITY, RACE_DESC, DATE_CREATED, PERSON_PHONE_WORK, RACE_CODE, PERSON_PHONE_CELL, R.UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID, MPI, IS_DUPLICATE, REMOVED, PROCESS_DATE, CURRENT_PROCESS_STATUS, CLEARTEXT_PAYLOAD, HIE_NAME, PAYLOADNAME, PERSON_ADDRESS_ID, CCD_DOC_ID, ADDRESS_USE, PERSON_ADDRESS_1, PERSON_ADDRESS_2, PERSON_CITY, PERSON_STATE, PERSON_ZIP, PERSON_COUNTRY, USEABLE_PERIOD_LOW, USEABLE_PERIOD_HIGH, ADDRESS_SEQ_NO, ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY c.ccd_doc_id ORDER BY c.address_use DESC, c.address_seq_no) rn FROM raw_ccd_doc r, raw_ccd_person_address c WHERE r.document_id = c.ccd_doc_id(+) AND r.current_process_status IN (1,4) ) WHERE rn = 1

SELECT distinct UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_ADDRESS_1,'"','')))||' '||UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_ADDRESS_2,'"',''))) PERSONADDRESS, UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_CITY,'"',''))) city, UPPER(trim(replace(PERSON_STATE,'"',''))) state, NVL(trim(PERSON_ZIP),'') zip FROM RAW_CCD_PERSON_ADDRESS WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID} and (PERSON_ADDRESS_1 is not null or PERSON_ADDRESS_2 is not null or PERSON_CITY is not null or PERSON_STATE is not null or PERSON_ZIP is not null) order by PERSONADDRESS

SELECT DISTINCT TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') startdate, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') startDateText, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(END_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') endDateText, UPPER(trim(NVL(PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_MNAME,'')|| ' '||NVL(PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as providerFullName, UPPER(trim(REPLACE(NVL(PROVIDER_ADDRESS_1,''),'"','')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_ADDRESS_2,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_CITY,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_STATE,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_ZIP,''))) as providerAddress, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(NVL(PROVIDER_PHONE,''), 'mailto:', ''), 'tel:', ''),'ext:','') phone FROM RAW_CCD_PROVIDER where CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID} AND ( START_DATE_TEXT is not null OR PROVIDER_FNAME is not null or PROVIDER_LNAME is not null or PROVIDER_ADDRESS_1 is not null or END_DATE_TEXT is not null or PROVIDER_PHONE is not null ) ORDER BY startdate

SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(trim(FACILITY_NAME)) facilityName, UPPER(trim(NVL(PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '|| NVL(PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as providerFullName, UPPER(trim(PROBLEM_CATEGORY)) problemCategory, PROBLEM_CODE problemCode, UPPER(trim(PROBLEM_DISPLAY_NAME)) problemDisplayName, ENCOUNTER_ID encounterId FROM RAW_CCD_PROBLEM where CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}

WITH data AS ( SELECT ENCOUNTER_DOC_ID encounterDocId, TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') START_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') startDateText, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(END_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') endDateText, ENCOUNTER_TYPE encounterType, UPPER(trim(NVL(PROVIDER_FNAME,'')|| ' '||NVL(PROVIDER_LNAME,''))) as providerFullName, ENCOUNTER_ID encounterId, FACILITY_TYPE facilityType, CASE WHEN FACILITY_NAME LIKE '%.%.%.%' AND PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME LIKE '%.%.%.%' THEN NULL WHEN PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME LIKE '%.%.%.%' THEN FACILITY_NAME WHEN FACILITY_NAME IN ('HWORKS','eClinicalWorks','AFMP','DOHCHS','LIFQHC','WFRCHC','eCW: BRKHC - Boriken Health Center') THEN PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME WHEN FACILITY_NAME IN ('NYCDOHMH Community Healthcare Network','NYCDOHMH-Project Renewal','NYDOHMH - Help PSI Services Corp','eCW: Brightpoint Health') THEN PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME WHEN FACILITY_NAME IN ('%eCW: Pediatrics 2000%','NYPL','NYUMC','SSFMA','DRCGC','DRETF','Prominis Medical Services') THEN PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME WHEN FACILITY_NAME is null THEN PARTICIPANT_FACILITY_NAME ELSE FACILITY_NAME END AS text FROM RAW_CCD_ENCOUNTER a WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID} ) SELECT DISTINCT a.start_date,a.startDateText,a.endDateText, UPPER(trim(Nvl(b.facility_name, a.text))) facilitydetails,UPPER(trim(a.facilityType)) facilityType,UPPER(trim(a.providerFullName)) providerFullName,UPPER(trim(a.encounterType)) encounterType,a.encounterId,a.encounterDocId FROM data a, CODED_HIE_FACILITY b WHERE a.text = b.FACILITY_CODE(+) order by a.START_DATE

Select distinct UPPER(trim(DIAGNOSIS_TEXT)) diagnosisText, UPPER(trim(DIAGNOSIS_CODE)) diagnosisCode from raw_ccd_diagnosis where ENCOUNTER_DOC_ID = #{encounterDocId} and (DIAGNOSIS_TEXT is not null or DIAGNOSIS_CODE is not null)

select CCD_LAB_TEST_ID ccdLabTestId, TO_DATE(substr(TEST_DATE,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') testdateorder, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(TEST_DATE,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') testdate, TEST_CODE testCode, CASE WHEN UPPER(trim(nvl(TEST_CODE_DISPLAY_NAME, TEST_COMMENTS))) LIKE '.%' THEN substr(UPPER(trim(nvl(TEST_CODE_DISPLAY_NAME, TEST_COMMENTS))), 2,length(UPPER(trim(nvl(TEST_CODE_DISPLAY_NAME, TEST_COMMENTS))))-0) ELSE UPPER(trim(nvl(TEST_CODE_DISPLAY_NAME, TEST_COMMENTS))) END testCodeDisplayName, TEST_ENCOUNTER_NUMBER testEncounterNumber, UPPER(trim(SPECIMEN)) specimen from raw_ccd_lab_test WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID} order by testdateorder, testCode

select resultDateText, componentCode, componentDisplayName, resultValue, resultStatus from (select TO_DATE(substr(RESULT_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') resultdate, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(RESULT_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') resultDateText, COMPONENT_CODE componentCode, UPPER(trim(COMPONENT_DISPLAY_NAME)) componentDisplayName, UPPER(trim(RESULT_VALUE)) resultValue, UPPER(trim(RESULT_STATUS)) resultStatus, UPPER(trim(RESULT_COMMENTS)) resultComments from raw_ccd_lab_result WHERE CCD_LAB_TEST_ID = #{ccdLabTestId} order by resultdate)

select DISTINCT TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD') startdate, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(START_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') startDateText, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(STOP_DATE_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') stopDateText, UPPER(trim(ORDERED_MEDICATION_NAME)) orderedMedicationName, UPPER(trim(FILLED_MEDICATION_NAME)) filledMedicationName, UPPER(trim(NVL(ORDERING_PROV_FNAME,'')|| ' '||NVL(ORDERING_PROV_LNAME,''))) as providerFullName from raw_ccd_med WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID} ORDER BY startdate

select DISTINCT UPPER(trim(POLICY_NAME)) policyName, NVL(REPLACE(MEMBER_ID,'-',''),'') memberId, UPPER(trim(NVL(MEMBER_FNAME,'')|| ' '||NVL(MEMBER_LNAME,''))) memberFullName, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(substr(MEMBER_DOB_TEXT,0,8),'YYYYMMDD'),'MM/DD/YYYY') memberDobText from raw_ccd_payer WHERE CCD_DOC_ID = #{CCD_DOC_ID}
mapper.insert: insert into UPHN_TRANX_IN (UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID, PAYLOADNAME, ORGNAME, TOPIC, RECEIVEDTIME, LASTUPDATETIME) values(UPHN_TRANX_IN_SEQ_ID.nextval,#{p_fileName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{p_hieName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DEERPROD', #{p_dateCreated, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE)
mapper.update: update UPHN_TRANX_IN set PAYLOADBINARYCONTENT = #{p_ccdDocument} where UPHN_TRANX_IN_ID = #{uphnId}
